packet_dag.terminal_condition: The One Time student review portal has a readable first page title and non-clipped review metric cards on desktop and mobile without changing student data, auth, forms, or APIs.

title: Student Review Mobile Readability Cleanup

reasons: Fresh screenshots show the student review title area rendered dark-on-dark and difficult to read.
Long reward/status values are rendered in hero-scale metric text, clipping on mobile and overflowing on desktop.
The defect can be scoped to One Time review-mode CSS and review metric markup without student data or API changes.
likely_external_provider_blockers: Student auth, questions, class links, payments, email, WhatsApp, Stripe, Drive, Vimeo, Zoom, DNS, access grants, and account mutations are out of scope.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: After this student review readability cleanup, continue manual screenshot-reviewed packets for Operations participants CRM layout or automation center contrast.

operator_intent_summary: Make the One Time student review portal look even and clean by fixing unreadable title copy and clipped metric text.

decisions_captured.decision: Production deploy/live-smoke target is still required before terminal app-visible Done.

out_of_scope: No parent portal, provider portal, member login, public landing, Operations, or classroom UI change.
No student auth, access-code, session, question submit, support ticket, class link, payment, progress, attendance, badge, reward, or API behavior change.
No email, WhatsApp, Telegram, Stripe/payment, access grant, Drive, Vimeo, Zoom, DNS, account mutation, publish, send, upload, or delete.
No GHL runtime, LeadConnector reference, external CRM write, raw private evidence, or secret exposure.

known_blockers: Production deploy/live-smoke remains blocked until a target is explicit.
observed_visual_defects: The top student review title block is low contrast and hard to read on mobile and desktop.
The hero review metric for reward status clips the value ready_for_rabbi_review on mobile and overflows the card on desktop.
The sidebar trial/access metric also uses oversized metric typography for a status string.

expanded_phrases.clean: The student review title and key review metrics should be readable at first glance without raw/clipped status strings.
expanded_phrases.even: Metric cards should use consistent fixed dimensions and compact text treatment across desktop and mobile.
expanded_phrases.loads nicely: The first rendered student review screen should show readable title, intro, and metrics immediately after the review data loads.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: The student review route remains a first-party One Time portal scoped to one TEST student in rabbi_sheller_provider / one_time_mishnah_class.

requirements.statement: Fix One Time student review readability so the first title block and review metrics do not render dark-on-dark or clip long status values.
requirements.expected_result: Desktop and mobile student-review screenshots show a readable top title/intro and metric cards whose long values wrap or scale within the card boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: One Time review mode applies a readable title/intro hero treatment on /student.html?review=one-time.
Review-only metric cards use a compact class so long achievement/reward/status strings wrap without horizontal clipping.
The sidebar trial/access metric and the hero reward metric remain visible and readable on 1440px and 390px screenshots.
Student review forms, buttons, links, student data, auth, APIs, and external-provider behavior are unchanged.

criteria: Raw source and broad UI cleanup register exist for RAW-20260702-008.
Current screenshot evidence shows the student review readability and clipping defects.
The likely fix is scoped to review-mode CSS and review-only metric markup.
No student data, auth, external provider, money, access, or credential decision is required for local implementation.
